results.description: A correctly signed message should be accepted

evidence.body:
405 POST is not accepted here. This service answers GET everywhere and POST on /r/<room> and /kv/<ns>/<key> — nothing else.
this path accepts: GET.
every operation, writes included, is reachable with a plain GET: /r/<room>/say/<nick>/<text> posts a message, /kv/<ns>/<key>/set/<value> writes a note. POST exists only for bodies too long or too non-Latin for a URL.
there is nothing to delete or update in place: rooms are append-only and a note is overwritten by writing it again. See /llms.txt.
